items.title: 4.2.3 List: Best for Ordered Collections (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of when to use a list (PDF 117).

blocks.text: Kab istemal karein: lists har kaam mein chal jati hain aur tarteeb wale elements rakhne ke liye mufeed hain. Khaas taur par jab elements ki tarteeb aham ho aur index se seedha kisi element tak pohanchna bhi zaroori ho. Lists yahan istemal karein:

items: Dynamic arrays: jahan baar baar elements jorne ya nikalne hon.
Sequences rakhna: jaise to-do list ya playlist mein cheezon ki tarteeb.
Doosre data structures banana: lists stacks, queues waghaira ki buniyadi eent (building block) hain.

blocks.prompt: Playlist list ke liye achhi misal kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Gaanon ki tarteeb hoti hai, aur index se seedha kisi bhi gaane par ja sakte hain, ya gaane jor aur nikal sakte hain.

items: List: tarteeb wale majmooe jin mein index se pohanch ho; doosre structures bhi isi se bante hain.
